# Plateau Design

> Plateau Design is a landscape architecture and design studio based in the World Heritage-listed Blue Mountains, NSW, Australia, with a second studio in Surry Hills, Sydney. It is led by Registered Landscape Architect Baz Richards and designs vibrant, inclusive and playful spaces that enrich communities and support local ecosystems.

## Studio

- Founded in early 2025 by Baz Richards, a Registered Landscape Architect with over 15 years of experience across Australia and internationally. Baz previously held design leadership positions at Sydney landscape architecture practices Context and Place Design Group, and was most recently Principal at RPS.
- Member of the Australian Institute of Landscape Architects (AILA).
- The studio designs on the traditional lands of the Dharug and Gundungurra people.

## Fields of work

- Parks and open spaces (new and upgraded parks)
- Play spaces (award-winning inclusive play)
- Learning spaces (outdoor environments for education)
- Urban spaces (streets, plazas and shared courtyards)
- Multi-level residential landscapes
- Gardens (planting-led design)

## Services

- Strategy reports, master plans, concept design and visualisations
- Landscape DA packages, detailed design and construction documentation (hardworks and planting)
- Costing opinions (OPC) and construction phase services
- Landscape and Visual Impact Assessments (LVIA)
- Plans of Management (POM) and maintenance plans
- Community engagement strategies and facilitation
